# Bash assignment-substitution: actually only fires under `set -e`

Counter-finding to `wiki/learnings/bash-discipline.md`. The existing article
states the gotcha applies "even with `set -euo pipefail`". A focused repro
shows the suppression only happens under `set -e` (the `-u` and `-o pipefail`
flags don't contribute). This **changes the meaning** of the existing claim
— Lane 2. The target article does NOT carry an in-doc invitation footer.
Route to `wiki/_drafts/` with `confidence` + `reason` + `source_count`.
